habitatCorrections.enemy-skeeter: Wild Skeeter is a real dataset name; use source-verified Wild Stinger alias for explicit Camp Kidney native identity.
habitatCorrections.enemy-spidertoad: Spider Toad main-world spawns are chiefly around Pimpleback Mountains; neighboring frog variants occur around Really Twisted Forest.
habitatCorrections.enemy-growth: Ghoulish Growth occurs around the Jungle Outpost / Mount Blackhead; a few source spawn rows are close to Camp Kidney, but this does not prove an exact region boundary.
habitatCorrections.enemy-stalker: Canyon Stalker main-world spawns cluster around Devil's Bluff, not Camp Kidney.
habitatCorrections.enemy-dreadhead: Dread Head is a genuine XDT name. Nearby original main-world junkyard spawns use the Tread Head variant of the same tire model.
habitatCorrections.enemy-shocktangler: Shocktangler mission text explicitly names Sector V; main-world cable-model spawns also occur near Goat's Junk Yard. Retained as a themed guest unless exact spawn boundary evidence is added.
habitatCorrections.enemy-streetgrinder: Original main-world spawns cluster around City Station / City Point, not Salvage Yard.
habitatCorrections.enemy-unisickle: Original main-world spawns cluster around Downtown locations (Townsville Park / City Hall / City Station / Habitat Homes), not Salvage Yard.
